Berries and Basil

Berries & Basil Kombucha bursts with juicy mixed berries—think strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries—lifted by a hint of fresh basil. Lightly fizzy and tangy-sweet, it’s packed with live probiotics for a vibrant, herbaceous twist on gut-friendly refreshment.

DETAILS

Our Kombucha is brewed in small batches using a premium green-black tea blend, real mixed-berry purée, and hand-picked basil leaves. Lightly fizzy and tangy-sweet with an herbaceous finish, it’s alive with live probiotic cultures to support your gut health. Serve chilled for best flavor.

INGREDIENTS + STORAGE
  • Filtered water, tea (Camellia sinensis), organic cane sugar
  • Mixed-berry purée (strawberry, raspberry, blueberry)
  • Organic basil leaves, live kombucha culture (SCOBY)
  • Refrigerate at 35–40 °F; keep upright and consume by “Best By” date
BOTTLE + NUTRITION
  • 16 fl oz (473 ml) reusable glass bottle
  • Serving size: 8 fl oz (237 ml)
  • Calories: 30 per serving
  • Probiotics: 1 billion CFU per serving
  • Sugar: 3 g per serving
FEATURES
  • Juicy strawberry, raspberry & blueberry infusion
  • Fresh basil aroma and flavor
  • Naturally fermented in glass vessels
  • Non-GMO, gluten-free
  • Brewed from premium tea
  • Live probiotic cultures
  • Enhances energy
